chunks.text: Two complementary illustrations help convey both (i) what a “vanilla” autoencoder represents, and (ii) how it gets implemented as a neural network. Several versions of these files are included, in the [Portable Document Format (PDF)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/PDF). see also: - [00-Autoencoder-panoramic.pdf](/thoughts/autoencoder-diagrams-intuition/00-Autoencoder-panoramic.pdf) - [Autoencoder-Implementation-simple.pdf](/thoughts/autoencoder-diagrams-intuition/Autoencoder-Implementation-simple.pdf) - [Autoencoder-Implementation.pdf](/thoughts/autoencoder-diagrams-intuition/Autoencoder-Implementation.pdf) - [Autoencoder-Representation-simple.pdf](/thoughts/autoencoder-diagrams-intuition/Autoencoder-Representation-simple.pdf) - [Autoencoder-Representation.pdf](/thoughts/autoencoder-diagrams-intuition/Autoencoder-Representation.pdf) ## License Autoencoder Diagrams by Keenan Crane is marked CC0 1.0
